tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Fetch one Advisable insight or news article by slug, as plain readable text.

language.description: Language code. Defaults to the language of the current domain.

tools.name: get_page_context
tools.description: Return what the visitor is currently looking at on the Advisable website: URL, path, page type and the language of this domain.

tools.name: list_clients
tools.description: List Advisable clients and case-study companies with industry, country and website.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List Advisable products (Ecommercen, SizeTheMarket, Findloom, e-Prescription, Recommendable).

language.description: Language code. Defaults to the language of the current domain.

tools.name: list_seminars
tools.description: List upcoming Advisable Academy seminars with dates, times, venue, seats and pricing, plus the page to book them.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List Advisable services (digital agency, technology, AI services, venture studio) with slug, title and page URL.

language.description: Language code. Defaults to the language of the current domain.

tools.name: navigate_to
tools.description: Navigate the browser to a page of the Advisable website. Use a relative path such as /academy, /insights or /contact.

tools.name: prepare_contact_request
tools.description: Prefill the Advisable contact form with the visitor details and open it. The form is bot protected, so the visitor has to press submit themselves. This tool never sends the request on its own.

interest.description: For example: AI Services, Training, Technology, Digital Marketing.

tools.name: prepare_seminar_interest
tools.description: Open the Advisable Academy page with a prefilled interest note for a seminar or corporate training. The visitor confirms and submits the form themselves.

tools.name: search_insights
tools.description: Search Advisable insights and news articles by keyword. Returns slug, title, excerpt, published date and the page URL.

query.description: Keyword to search titles and excerpts.

language.description: Language code. Defaults to the language of the current domain.
